title: Incorrect `ERC20` transfer in `withdrawFee` prevents fee withdrawal
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `AdminOperationalTreasury.withdrawFee()` function uses `safeTransferFrom()` instead of `safeTransfer()` when withdrawing protocol fees. This is incorrect because:  1. `safeTransferFrom()` requires the spender to have an allowance from the owner. 2. The contract is trying to transfer from itself (`address(this)`) to the recipient. 3.
